name: Company Discovery -- First Build
status: reference only -- a one-time build run, never scheduled
description: Builds Entities.md and the Customer/Partner hubs from captured mail, once. Afterwards, the nightly Metadata pass keeps them current with append-only discovery; this first build is the only run allowed to write Entities.md from scratch.

steps.name: Group senders by domain
steps.description: entity-domain-extraction/build_entities_report.py -- mechanical, no model. REWRITES Entities.md, which is why it is never scheduled: after the operator's first review, that file is curation.

steps.name: Operator review
steps.description: The operator classifies Customer vs Partner, sets Ignore, merges domains into Aliases, names Affiliates. Nothing proceeds until this is done.

steps.name: Create the hubs
steps.description: create-companies-partners/create_companies_partners.py -- hubs, Affiliates under their parents, People moved into place, company tags.

steps.name: Fill the profiles
steps.description: A model fills each hub's Summary once, so no Customer profile starts empty.

notes: Nightly, the Metadata pipeline runs new-company-discovery/find_new_entities.py instead: it APPENDS unseen domains as `Ignore: Yes` and never touches an existing entry.
Discovery by domain only finds companies someone emailed. Enrichment adds the rest -- a company discussed in a body or an attachment -- to a review list.
